<section class="portfolio-group" id="reliable-ai">
  <header class="portfolio-group__header"><h2>AI security and reliable releases</h2><p>Systems that make product risk, model change, and release decisions explicit and independently checkable.</p></header>
  <div class="portfolio-grid">
    <article class="portfolio-card portfolio-card--core">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Core selection</span><span>Research preview</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ContextSec">ContextSec</a></h3>
      <p>A deterministic product-security decision layer for AI coding agents. It derives applicable controls from bounded repository evidence and records every decision in a Control Evaluation Ledger.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-proof"><strong>Evidence surfaced</strong> 16 risk packs, 116 controls, 9 composition rules, profile and mutation cases, real-repository evaluations, and multi-platform CI.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ContextSec">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ContextSec/blob/main/docs/architecture.md">Architecture</a></p>
    </article>
    <article class="portfolio-card portfolio-card--core">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Core selection</span><span>Pre-alpha</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/Merriv">Merriv</a></h3>
      <p>A vendor-neutral release-evidence layer for deployable AI models. It binds exact artifacts, paired evaluation, statistical policy, provenance, and regression onset into a portable Model Change Report.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-proof"><strong>Evidence surfaced</strong> Reproducible release records, explicit promotion policy, provenance, regression localization, and an independent verification path.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/Merriv">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/Merriv/blob/main/docs/release-evidence-case-study.md">Case study</a></p>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="portfolio-group" id="repository-reasoning">
  <header class="portfolio-group__header"><h2>Repository and research reasoning</h2><p>Tools that constrain automation with inspectable evidence, explicit review boundaries, and reproducible intermediate artifacts.</p></header>
  <div class="portfolio-grid portfolio-grid--three">
    <article class="portfolio-card portfolio-card--core">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Core selection</span><span>Public alpha</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ai-repo-gardener">AI Repo Gardener</a></h3>
      <p>Static analysis and a portable Agent Skill for AI-edited Python repositories. Weak findings stay review-only, while deletion requires a reviewed, hash-bound plan and isolated validation.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-proof"><strong>Evidence surfaced</strong> Import reachability, Git chronology, normalized AST evidence, 25 adversarial safety scenarios, real-repository smoke tests, and multi-platform CI.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ai-repo-gardener">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ai-repo-gardener/blob/main/benchmarks/safety-benchmark.md">Safety benchmark</a></p>
    </article>
    <article class="portfolio-card">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Supporting work</span><span>Research tool</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/NoveltyAudit">NoveltyAudit</a></h3>
      <p>Evidence-first tooling for adversarial scholarly novelty audits, including claim decomposition, historical cutoffs, minimal prior sets, and bridge-aware prior-work analysis.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/NoveltyAudit">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/NoveltyAudit#readme">Documentation</a></p>
    </article>
    <article class="portfolio-card">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Supporting work</span><span>Early alpha</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/research-meeting-coach">Research Meeting Coach</a></h3>
      <p>An evidence-grounded Agent Skill that turns raw research progress into decision-ready advisor meetings while keeping every claim within the supplied evidence.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/research-meeting-coach">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/research-meeting-coach#readme">Documentation</a></p>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="portfolio-group" id="visual-systems">
  <header class="portfolio-group__header"><h2>Visual evidence and interactive systems</h2><p>Applied systems for preserving weak visual signals and integrating heterogeneous tools into coherent interfaces.</p></header>
  <div class="portfolio-grid">
    <article class="portfolio-card portfolio-card--core">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Core selection</span><span>Public alpha</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ChromaRecover">ChromaRecover</a></h3>
      <p>A local-first computer-vision toolkit for recovering spatial structure carried by subtle color differences. It tests competing hypotheses, preserves auditable artifacts, and abstains when evidence is weak.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-proof"><strong>Evidence surfaced</strong> Masks, overlays, quality signals, provenance, uncertainty states, and algorithm notes.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ChromaRecover">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/ChromaRecover/blob/main/docs/algorithm.md">Algorithm notes</a></p>
    </article>
    <article class="portfolio-card">
      <div class="portfolio-card__meta"><span>Supporting work</span><span>Interactive system</span></div>
      <h3><a href="https://github.com/niansia/fusion-os">Fusion OS</a></h3>
      <p>A desktop-like environment that integrates more than 25 interactive applications through a C# and WebView2 shell with a React and TypeScript interface.</p>
      <p class="portfolio-card__links"><a href="https://github.com/niansia/fusion-os">Code</a><span>/</span><a href="https://github.com/niansia/fusion-os#readme">Overview</a></p>
